description: This file contains utility functions for managing disk cache directories, including cleanup, size calculation, and cache deletion, primarily used within Chromium's disk cache subsystem.

methods.name: GetPrefixedName
methods.description: Generates a filename with a prefix and index, used for old cache folders.

methods.name: GetTempCacheName
methods.description: Finds a temporary cache directory name that does not exist yet.

methods.name: CleanupTemporaryDirectories
methods.description: Deletes old cache directories in the background.

methods.name: MoveDirectoryToTemporaryDirectory
methods.description: Renames a cache directory to a temporary location for cleanup.

methods.name: CleanupDirectoryInternal
methods.description: Performs the internal cleanup process, including renaming and scheduling deletion.

methods.name: PreferredCacheSizeInternal
methods.description: Calculates preferred cache size based on available space.
